summary.text: James Pierson is the Republican candidate for the Rhode Island State Senate, District 33, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having won the September 9, 2026 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists him as a current member of the Coventry Public Schools board, District 5, and he was also the Republican nominee for the same Senate seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: James Pierson won the 2024 Republican primary for Rhode Island State Senate District 33 and lost the general election to incumbent Democrat Leonidas Raptakis, 41.5 percent to 58.2 percent.
Ballotpedia reports that Pierson signed the U.S. Term Limits Pledge.
